method: Reduce a perfect split solvable-by-A5 subgroup of GL4(3) to order 60*2^a*3^b with 0<=a<=7 and 0<=b<=5. Enumerate the complete GAP PerfectGroups library at those orders, retain groups whose solvable radical is the full kernel, quotient is A5, and A5 complements exist. Candidates with nontrivial 3-core cannot act faithfully and irreducibly in characteristic three; compute all four-dimensional irreducible image orders for the remaining candidates.
scope: This is exhaustive for perfect split solvable-by-A5 action images on an irreducible four-dimensional F3 chief factor. It does not prove that every z-carrying chief factor of an arbitrary solvable seam kernel has total dimension four.
